result.rationale: In AddGuestsDialog.tsx, onError sets isInvalidEmail but the onSuccess path (`setIsOpenDialog(false); setMultiEmailValue([""])`) never resets isInvalidEmail, and the dialog open handler doesn't reset it either. Only the cancel button resets it (`setIsInvalidEmail(false)`). So a user who triggers the error, then fixes and submits successfully, sees a stale 'emails_must_be_unique_valid' error on reopen. Minor UI state bug, verifiable in the diff.

adjudication.rationale: In `AddGuestsDialog`, `isInvalidEmail` is set to `true` when validation fails (`handleAdd`), and the error banner renders whenever `isInvalidEmail` is true. On mutation success, the code closes the dialog and resets `multiEmailValue` (`onSuccess: setIsOpenDialog(false); setMultiEmailValue([""]);`) but never resets `isInvalidEmail` back to `false`. Since the dialog component stays mounted (it’s always rendered in `BookingListItem` and `Dialog open={isOpenDialog}` just toggles visibility), reopening can show the error message even with freshly reset inputs.
